name: coder
description: Implements one small, well-specified code change with unit tests: plans it, has the local model write it step by step, runs lint and tests, reviews, commits per step, and opens a pull request when green.
when_to_use: Any concrete code change: a helper, a reducer case, a component tweak, a bug fix with a regression test. Not for open-ended design work or changes spanning many files.
inputs: Exact files or areas, the behaviour to implement, names to use, what tests must exist or stay green. Mention e2e specs that cover the area.
outputs: A branch agentpipe/<slug>-<date> with one commit per step, a report, and a pull request when the project pushes.
